# Official Espressif G.722 API fixture

Unmodified public headers from esp_audio_codec 2.5.0, commit a791bb959b2c53ca3db87131ef8f3b6c500511f2.

The host contract test substitutes only the implementation behind these headers.
It does not execute the target-specific Espressif archives or qualify firmware.
Original copyright and license notices remain in each header.
